connectionFields.name: Nickname
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: GitLab URL
connectionFields.obtainedHow: https://gitlab.com or the self-managed base URL.

connectionFields.name: Access Token
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Group or project access token with read_api/read_repository; store in the operator vault.

operatorInputs.validation: Non-empty label; letters, digits, spaces, and hyphens.

prepSteps.title: Create a GitLab access token
prepSteps.instruction: In GitLab, create a group or project access token with Entro's read scopes and store it in the operator vault.
prepSteps.evidence: GitLab shows an access token named for Entro (value stored outside the session)

typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: glab token create --name entro --scopes read_api,read_repository (group or project as locked); operator stores the token in the vault
typedActions.expectedChange: GitLab shows an access token named for Entro (value stored outside the session)
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Revoke the token created this run (glab token revoke)
